text:
sam: Anyone have a shortlink to the Grafana panel for inference-fleet (us-east)? I click the ops tile and get a 403 :confused:

lina: If you need the panel shortlink it's under /d/ops-inference — lemme grab it. Also check RBAC, many folks hit 403 when they're not in the ops org

sam: yup i'm `eng-runtime` and seeing 403 even when opening the dashboard directly

ops-bot: Heads up: Grafana access requires membership in the `engineers-obsv` group or the `ops_viewer` role. Use /request-grafana-access to request access.

mike: pinging @jordan from infra to share the exact panel link and do a quick RBAC check

jordan: shortlink: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/inference-fleet-overview?orgId=1&viewPanel=7

sam: pasted that and still 403 :(

jordan: you're not in `engineers-obsv` — adding you now

infra-bot: Action: user 'sam' added to group 'engineers-obsv' by 'jordan'

sam: can see it now, nice :tada: quick Q — there are a bunch of dev alerts firing for this tile, which alert should I mute while we iterate?

lina: for dev/staging the alert `inf-fleet-p95-high-dev` is noisy. Better to adjust threshold in alertmanager rather than mute. I opened a PR to bump dev threshold: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/678

mike: thanks Lina. @sam — if you need temporary silence, use Alertmanager -> Silences and target `inf-fleet-p95-high-dev`, but let's prefer the PR

sam: got it. thanks everyone. noted the /request-grafana-access shortcut for future folks

lina: also adding a brief runbook note to the dashboard: how to request access and which alerts are dev-only

sam: perfect, closing the loop :white_check_mark:
